recipes.name: Spicy beef bulgogi (Maeun-sobulgogi: 매운소불고기)
ingredients: 1 pound sirloin beef steak (or any tender cut of beef), sliced thinly
4 green onions, cut into 2½ inch long pieces
1 king oyster mushroom, sliced thinly lengthwise
½ cup fermented kimchi (preferably well-fermented and sour-tasting), chopped, optional
¼ cup gochu-garu (Korean hot pepper flakes)
¼ cup rice syrup (or corn syrup, or sugar to your taste)
¼ cup gochujang (Korean hot pepper paste)
instructions: Combine the ingredients for marinade in a medium bowl. Mix well with a wooden spoon. Mix beef into the marinade by hand. Set aside until you're ready to cook.

Heat up a large, heavy, and shallow pan or skillet over medium high heat. Add the cooking oil, green onion, and mushroom. Stir it for 1 minute with a wooden spoon until the green onion turns slightly light brown. Turn down the heat to medium and add the marinated beef. Cook, stirring with a wooden spoon for 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and transfer the bulgogi to a large plate. Serve with rice, kimchi, and more side dishes. Eat ssam syle (see below).

instruction_sections.text: Directions
Marinate beef
Combine the ingredients for marinade in a medium bowl. Mix well with a wooden spoon.
Mix beef into the marinade by hand.
Set aside until you’re ready to cook.
Cook bulgogi
Cook on the stove
Heat up a large, heavy, and shallow pan or skillet over medium high heat. Add the cooking oil, green onion, and mushroom.
Stir it for 1 minute with a wooden spoon until the green onion turns slightly light brown.
Turn down the heat to medium and add the marinated beef. Cook, stirring with a wooden spoon for 3 to 5 minutes.
Remove from the heat and transfer the bulgogi to a large plate.
Serve with rice, kimchi, and more side dishes.
Eat ssam syle (see below).
Cook at the table just like a Korean restaurant

On your table, set out Korean side dishes (banchan) like kimchi, as well as lettuce, ssamjang, and sliced garlic for lettuce wraps. Bring your drinks, plates, chopsticks and rice. Set out everything around a cooking surface (like a Korean butane gas burner) set in the middle of the table.
Heat up a large, heavy, and shallow pan or skillet over medium high heat. Add the cooking oil, green onion, and mushroom.
Stir it for 1 minute with a wooden spoon until the green onion turns slightly light brown.
Turn down the heat to medium and add the marinated beef. Cook, stirring with a wooden spoon for 3 to 5 minutes.
Eat ssam style (see below) at the table.
Serve and eat ssam style
Put a piece of meat on a lettuce leaf with some ssamjang, a slice of green chili pepper (if you can handle it) and garlic (also optional). Make it small enough to eat in one bite.
Wrap up the lettuce leaf around everything and eat it in one bite!
Everyone makes their own wrap, one by one, until they are finished.
Make bokkeumbap (stir-fried rice)
After the bulgogi is cooked and eaten, you’ll have some spicy sauce and bits of meat in the bottom of the pan. Add rice and chopped kimchi and stir-fry for just a few minutes.
Scoop some out in individual bowls and serve.
